itemIds.title: Item IDs
itemIds.description: 1688 offer ids, found in the listing URL: detail.1688.com/offer/612345678901.html. A pasted URL works too — the id is read out of it rather than sent as-is.

itemUrls.title: Item URLs
itemUrls.description: 1688 listing URLs instead of ids; the offer id is read out of each.

keyword.title: Search keyword
keyword.description: Search 1688 instead of naming ids, in Chinese or English, e.g. T恤 批发 or linear guide slider. Required for listing level, unless you search by image instead.

imageUrl.title: Search by image
imageUrl.description: Find the listing from a picture instead of words — a competitor's product photo, a shot of a sample. Upload the picture here, or paste its web address. Either way the data source fetches the image itself, so an address has to be public http(s); a link that cannot be read is refused before any search is paid for. An image and a keyword together search the image. Costs the same as a keyword search: one call per page of results.

detailLevel.title: Detail level
detailLevel.description: Full detail fetches each listing: the wholesale ladder and minimum order, variants, attributes and seller scores. Listing level sells the search results themselves — title, price, sales, supplier, image, and the ladder where the search result includes it (about half the time) — which is enough to shortlist on and costs a fraction, because one call returns a whole page. Listing level needs a search keyword or an image.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: The catalogue to read. 1688 today; Taobao and Tmall are planned and will appear here when the data source serves them.

quantity.title: Order quantity to price
quantity.description: How many pieces you intend to order. Each record then carries a quote: the unit price at that quantity resolved against the wholesale ladder (a range, cheapest to dearest, when the variants are priced apart and there is no ladder), the subtotal, which tier it landed on, and whether the quantity clears the seller's minimum. Leave empty to skip.

maxMinOrderQuantity.title: Only sellers whose minimum order is at most
maxMinOrderQuantity.description: Keep only listings whose minimum order (起订量) is this many pieces or fewer — e.g. 2 for samples or a small first order. When searching by keyword or image, search results whose price ladder already starts above it are dropped before any detail is fetched, so they cost you nothing. Listings left out are never billed and do not count towards Max products. A listing that states no minimum is kept. Leave empty to keep every listing.

maxProducts.title: Max products
maxProducts.description: Hard cap on products returned in this run. Each product returned with data is one billable event.

includeSkus.title: Include the SKU matrix
includeSkus.description: On: return every purchasable variant with its own options, price and stock. Off: keep records small and return the listing level only.

concurrency.title: Listings fetched at once
concurrency.description: How many listings to fetch in parallel. Higher is faster; lower it if your provider plan has a tight rate limit. Requests stay spaced by the interval below however many workers run.

minRequestInterval.title: Minimum seconds between requests
minRequestInterval.description: Seconds between calls to the data source, enforced across all workers — decimals allowed, e.g. 0.2. 0 removes the spacing, leaving parallelism as the only limit. Raise it if your provider plan has a tight rate limit.

sourceApiKey.title: Your own RapidAPI key (optional)
sourceApiKey.description: Leave empty to use the included data source. Supply a key only if your organisation holds its own OTAPI 1688 subscription on RapidAPI and needs calls made under it.
